[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-87[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Beautiful note snapshots in bob ref create[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob ref create sase_blog` turns any Bob vault note, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]area/project notes especially, into a calm, beautiful, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Highlights-safe PDF: a dated reading snapshot of the note's open [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]work and prose, with resolved links, embeds, and images. It renders[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the same on athena and the Mac, and every Highlights quote taken [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from it stays byte-clean.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]12[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]note_snapshots.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/note_snapshots.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-87[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-87/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bundled print fonts and glyph coverage[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]fonts[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fonts: vendor pinned static Source Serif 4, Inter, JetBrains Mono, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monochrome Noto Emoji faces, and expose a ttf-parser glyph-coverage API [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]for the print profile.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Snapshot view model and Obsidian layer[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]view-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]view-core: build the note_snapshot module. It classifies vault notes, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolves notes and attachments with Obsidian semantics, rewrites [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Obsidian syntax into the view model, and serializes the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]projected-Markdown contract with synthetic golden tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob layer for area and project notes[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]bob-layer[dim] · [dim][/dim]after view-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-layer: add the masthead from frontmatter and the ^prj line, status [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rows and chips, lane headings, BLOCKS and WAITS ON rows, condensed logs,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]closed-task omission with the -C appendix, and self-snapshot filtering.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Note print profile and two-step xelatex render[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]print-profile[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fonts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]print-profile: implement note.tex (the design system), note.lua [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](contract to TeX, AST-preserving), and a pandoc-to-.tex-then-xelatex [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]render that surfaces missing glyphs and errors, plus the doctor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]packages. Tested against a hand-written contract fixture.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob ref create integration, provenance, help, and docs[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]create-wiring[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bob-layer, print-profile[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]create-wiring: wire everything into create. Covers vault-note and route [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]TARGETs, -P default, dated stem and title, the notes ref type, -C and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]-M, dry-run and success output, the source_note marker field, listen [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]input, the help 'Vault notes' block, docs, and CLI tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Image embeds that print well[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]images[dim] · [dim][/dim]after create-wiring[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]images: copy embedded images into scratch, downscaled to at most 1600 px[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the long edge. Convert GIF and WebP, and give SVG and broken files a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]placeholder plus a warning.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Waiting-on and Scheduled lanes for tickler-heavy notes[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]scheduled-lane[dim] · [dim][/dim]after create-wiring[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]scheduled-lane: split the Blocked lane into dependency-blocked 'Waiting [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on' rows and date-blocked compact 'Scheduled' rows grouped by this week,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]this month, and later.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Section filter and earlier-snapshot hints[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]snapshot-options[dim] · [dim][/dim]after create-wiring[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshot-options: add repeatable -S/--section and list earlier snapshots[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of the same note in dry runs. Print a hint, never an action, when an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]earlier snapshot is still unread with no highlights.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Text-layer rule for the default Markdown profile[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]markdown-text-layer[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]markdown-text-layer: gated on default_text_layer. Make the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]research-report route ragged-right with no hyphenation and no common [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ligatures, and leave its reader and fonts as they are.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian command to snapshot the open note[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]plugin-command[dim] · [dim][/dim]after create-wiring[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plugin-command: gated on obsidian_command. Add a desktop-only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-plugins command that runs bob ref create on the active note, with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]-C variant, progress and result notices, then deploys with bob plugins [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sync.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  11 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Corpus gate on athena and long-tail fixes[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]corpus-gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after images, scheduled-lane[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]corpus-gate: add a dev script that renders every area/project note to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scratch with -o and dry-runs every vault note. Require zero failures, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]missing glyphs, and Type 3 body fonts. Visually review representative [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pages and fix the long tail.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  12 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac acceptance and the real Highlights round trip[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after corpus-gate, snapshot-options, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]markdown-text-layer, plugin-command[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-acceptance: deploy to the Mac and run the corpus gate under BasicTeX[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the PDFKit probe. Run Bryan's real Highlights round trip, record the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]verified results in docs, and write the decision record if it was [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]approved.[/#D7D7AF]
